status: UNAPPROVED CONCEPTS - not implemented in Android, not signed off
summary: Concepts for screens that do not exist yet (auth, profile, settings), plus two splash directions and a proposed light token set. Contains NO light versions of the existing screens.

scopeLimit.existingScreensNotIncluded: Light duplicates of home, player, collection, collection-empty, about, the two menus, the three sheets and full-history are deliberately absent. Their canonical source is the real Figma project. An earlier attempt reconstructed them from preview.html and the rendered PNGs and drifted from the approved design (wrong header text, section titles at y=96 instead of y=80, three stream cards instead of two, mini-player in the wrong state). Those reconstructions were removed rather than corrected.
scopeLimit.blockedOn: Direct access to the Figma frames. Once available: compare Figma against dark-theme/code.js, dark-theme/preview.html and dark-screens.json, record any drift with Figma taking precedence, and only then produce 1:1 light duplicates changing nothing but semantic tokens and contrast-driven details.

tokens.comment: Dark values are the approved set from dark-screens.json, repeated here so a light/dark pair can be read from one file. Light is NOT dark-with-a-white-background: the brand accents are re-derived so they stay legible, see accentPolicy.

accentPolicy.problem: The dark accents are chosen against a #0B1D31 background. On white, myataCyan #00E5FF (1.4:1), goldYellow #FFFF00 (1.07:1) and xtraPink #FFCCFF (1.3:1) are all unreadable as text or icons.
accentPolicy.rule: In light mode each brand colour has two roles. As a CONTAINER it keeps the vivid dark-mode value and carries dark text on top. As CONTENT (text, icons, stroke) it uses the darkened variant listed in tokens.light.brand*.
verified: disabledContent #8E969E on disabledContainer #E8EAED = 2.4:1 (non-text/disabled only, per WCAG 1.4.3 exemption)

lightSpecificDecisions: Elevation cannot be read from a lighter surface on white, so light mode separates surfaces with a 1px outline and a soft shadow instead of a raised fill. surface and surfaceElevated are deliberately the same value.
The bottom navigation becomes surface white with a top divider; in dark it is a distinct navigationContainer fill.
The mini-player stays a filled primary block in both themes - it is the one element that must read as 'active' at a glance.
Album artwork is user content and is never tinted; light mode adds a 1px outline so pale covers do not bleed into the white surface.
The scrim behind menus and sheets is scrim at 55% in light and 79% in dark.
